p.i: Procede tandem : Quid bona gaudia Vatum moraris ? nec caput exere Tantùm : sed alto sidera, sidera, Mirande vates, incute vertice Seu Flacce, Flacci seu genium magis Sortite vates. Fallor, an abdito Flaccum reducit tramite Cynthius ? Vocisne vana ludor imagine Flaccum sonantis, quisquis es, unicè ? Lauros, cothurnos, & lyricum melos, Et mixta multo nectare cynnama, Artemque nosco diuitis ingeni: At mox remotis talibus intimam Tractans, retractans, carminis indolem, Quàm multa cerno caelitus indita ! O quàm coruscò protinus emines Augustioris lumine gloriæ ! Nugas canoras, fella nefaria, Curasque segnes vinaque libera,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Tantùm" (accent uncertain), "Sortite" (possible grave accent over the final e), "ludor" (letters slightly blurred), "unicè" (accent uncertain). The top-left drop cap is a decorated P; the word is read as "Procede". Faint show-through of the reverse page is ignored. Printed page number: none visible.
